messages:
ravi: FYI planning the quarterly least-priv sweep. discovery-only pass Tue, enrichment (KMS + grants) Wed, and a small prune window Fri morning. scope: infra, analytics, and cross-account bindings. want eyes on the plan.

Tina: scope question: do we include vendor/third-party svcaccts (e.g., zapier, datadog)? they show up as admins in some projects.

alex: exclude vendor-managed CI principals by default. we'll include any service principal with a human owner tag=false but flag them for review rather than auto-revoke.

security-oncall: reminder: link CVE-2026-0423 triage running Wed 06:00 PT. if that escalates, pause any entitlement changes until clearance.

ravi: good call. we'll add a pre-check: `security-status --cves` must be clean. if not, abort.

infra-bot: AUDIT: current audit-ingest-lag red for org/redwood-prod: 210s. recommended threshold 120s.

alex: hold on the enrichment until ingest-lag < 120s. we rely on recent logs to prove owner activity.

Tina: KMS integration plan: I'll run `aws kms list-grants --key-id` and `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` then join grants to IAM bindings. outputs: `principal,kms_keys,bindings,last_auth` CSV.

ravi: perfect. add a column for evidence links (login events / console activity). we'll push CSV to shared drive and ping reviewers.

alex: propose owner notification workflow before any auto-removals. 48h ack window; if no ack, send pager to owner team; if still no response, route to infra-ops for manual hold.

Tina: I sketched a tiny notifier: ```owners=$(rbac-audit --stale-days 60 --format principals)
for o in $owners; do
  slack dm $o "Heads-up: quarterly entitlement review. you'll get a proposed change if something looks stale. reply 'ack' to stop automated action."
done
```

security-oncall: please include escalation contacts in the DM (team oncall + admin owner). also include rollback procedure link.

ravi: runbook notes: rollback = reapply role binding + re-grant KMS (see runbook snippet). smoke test after any change: `role-check --expect admin:team-leads` and `kms-verify --key-id <key> --expect-grant <principal>`. failures open a P0 incident and run auto-rollback.

infra-bot: SCHEDULE: dry-run Tue 10:00 PT (audit-only), enrichment Wed 11:00 PT, canary prune Fri 07:00 PT (small sample ~1%).

alex: will prepare CSV + preflight checklist. tagging @tina for KMS outputs.

Tina: I'll drop CSV with `principal,bindings,kms_keys,last_auth,evidence_url` and add a quick script to filter out vendor-managed principals.

ravi: final ask: add a metric to the dashboard for "post-prune failed admin checks" so we can catch any missed escalations quickly. retro Fri 10:30 PT. thanks all. :thumbsup:
